title: REGISTRATIONS OPEN
shortDesc: Squad applications officially launch across all tracks.
details: Assemble your squad of 1 to 4 members. Pick your battleground between Main Gaming and the VR Arena. Early team submissions receive priority qualifier scheduling.

title: QUALIFIER ROUND
shortDesc: Online preliminary playoffs to determine top seeds.
details: Knockout single-elimination tournament bracket. Top 16 squads from each competitive pool advance to the live LAN semi-finals at the AIT campus.

title: SEMI-FINALS
shortDesc: Main stage LAN brackets hosted at AIT Pune.
details: High-octane live LAN showdown on high-refresh tournament rigs and dedicated Meta Quest 3 headsets. Live audience viewing with shoutcasters and stage production.

title: GRAND FINALE
shortDesc: Championship finals, VR showcase, and awards ceremony.
details: Best-of-5 championship finals to crown the Genesis 2026 Champions followed by official prize disbursements and trophy celebrations.
